_comment: Hand-written golden decode of info-v1.bin (bead pico-link-jyhk.9) -- GET_INFO (0x04) has no Rust owner (firmware/src/usb_config_itf.c ~L362-382, pl_cfg_info_wire_t in usb_config_itf.h), so unlike the home-*.json files in this directory, this is NOT generated by `cargo test` and there is no UPDATE_FIXTURES path for it. If the firmware's default PL_CFG_*_VERSION or PL_FW_VERSION_STRING ever change, this file, info-v1.bin, and the C static-assert on sizeof(pl_cfg_info_wire_t) in usb_config_itf.h must all be updated together by hand.
